'''December 2000 Pleasanton tournament (second event)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Pleasanton, California on 16 December 2000. [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1554">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-pleasanton-ca-12-16-00d1554/ pleasanton-ca-12-16-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 17 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-pleasanton-ca-12-16-00d1554/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
